title: NORM_X and SCALE_X with negative bounds, outside the range and with an empty range
note: NORM_X(MIN, X, MAX) = (X - MIN) / (MAX - MIN) and SCALE_X(MIN, X, MAX) = MIN + X * (MAX - MIN): NORM_X(-10, 0, 10) = 0.5, NORM_X(0, 30, 20) = 1.5 (no clamping), NORM_X(-20, -15, -10) = 0.5, an empty range gives 0.0 instead of a division by zero; SCALE_X(-10, 0.5, 10) = 0, SCALE_X(-5, 1, -1) = -1
